text: I'm looking after my nephew, he's 11, and his temperature is 39.9. That's the highest I've ever seen on a thermometer and I'm really scared. He's also not been to the toilet for a poo in three days and he's in a right grump about it, complaining his tummy feels full. His parents are away and I don't know what's normal for him. Please tell me what I should do.
